intro.en: Custom waterproof wire harnesses are developed as complete sealed systems around the real exposure, mating state, cable entries, branches and agreed validation.
intro.zh: 定制防水设计线束需要围绕真实暴露、插合状态、出线、分支与约定验证，作为完整密封系统开发。

knowledge.en: IP67, IP68 and IP69K are different defined test questions; a component rating does not automatically transfer to a complete harness.
knowledge.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 对应不同规定试验，元件等级不会自动转移到完整线束。

notes.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, cable diameters, unused cavities, orientation, exposure, movement and required test method.
notes.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚表、线缆外径、空腔、方向、暴露、运动与所需试验方法。

delivery.en: Release records the sealing stack, preparation dimensions, assembly controls and project-specific evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录密封链、备线尺寸、装配控制与项目特定证据。

subtitle.zh: 水会沿着每一条未封闭路径前进

lead.en: Define the complete sealed system before production.
lead.zh: 生产前定义完整密封系统。
